q-106:
We add the corresponding entries:

$$
\begin{aligned}M+N & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -6 & 14 \\ 2 & 9 & -13\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-15 & -6 & -13 \\ -1 & -8 & 14\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3+(-15) & -6+(-6) & 14+(-13) \\ 2+(-1) & 9+(-8) & -13+14\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-12 & -12 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
